description: Defines the ITransactionalState<TState> interface which specifies transaction semantics and read/write locking for state management in Orleans grains.

classes.name: ITransactionalState
classes.description: Interface for transactional state with read/write capabilities respecting Orleans transaction semantics.

methods.name: PerformRead
methods.description: Performs a read-only operation on the state, returning a result without modifying the state.

methods.name: PerformUpdate
methods.description: Performs an update operation on the state, returning a result.
